title: The solution router and its catalogue: for each sub-problem the approaches that could solve it, ranked, each need judged met, unmet or unknown
request: Phase 2 of the owner's plan: after the problem is understood as parts, route each part to candidate solutions with reasons, adoptable by the main product.
spec: dclab_core.solutions (CATALOGUE, check, candidates_for, route, routes, the role SOLUTION_ROUTER, Route v1), the ledger point solution.route, the draft's routes and their view, the approach shown on Home.
plan: A catalogue whose entries are the engine's own kinds, each saying what it needs and which research track measured it.
Needs judged on the data card and the map, never guessed: unknown is a state, not a refusal.
A single problem keeps the detected kind; a model may only choose a candidate the data does not refute.

decisions.decision: A need is met, unmet or unknown; only an unmet need blocks.
decisions.why: No data card or no named outcome means the need cannot be judged yet, and a guess would refute the right approach.

decisions.decision: An outcome is the column the card names, for the one part that owns it, or the column a part's own words name; never the table's first candidate.
decisions.why: A card names one outcome: judging every part on it routes a ticket's team and urgency to a yes or no.

decisions.decision: The detected kind is used only for a single problem the rules drew, and the refutation is said when the data refutes it.
decisions.why: The detection is today's behaviour and is never replaced, but a person's own map says its own family, and a silent refusal hides the reason.

decisions.decision: The rings part has no approach when only the rides and the file of cases are uploaded.
decisions.why: The entity kind builds features from a table of events beside the cases; saying so tells the person what to bring.

change: dclab_core solutions.py and a prompt (new), problem_map tail import, agents, ledger, conformance, adapters, schemas, CHANGELOG 0.52.0; dclab_rnd draft/map.py, capture, models settings, harness roles, the Home page; tests test_solutions and the Home routing tests.

findings.defect: A column named got_offer was not found as a treatment.
findings.scenario: The uplift replica's treatment column is got_offer; the first router refused to route its own replica.
findings.cause: A word boundary does not break at an underscore.
findings.fix: Names are read as their words (got_offer, gotOffer, Got Offer are alike).

findings.defect: Another import cycle: the route contract registered from the contracts' tail while the problem map was half defined.
findings.scenario: Importing the problem map first failed and the Home tests were skipped without notice.
findings.cause: The same shape as the roles module of 24.2.
findings.fix: The contract registers from the end of the problem map; every module imports first in a fresh interpreter.

findings.defect: A guessed outcome refuted the right approach.
findings.scenario: Ticket words and the ticket-routing replica uploaded: both parts routed to binary because a two-valued flag was taken as the outcome, and two decisions of binary were recorded.
findings.cause: The outcome came from the table's first candidate when the card named none.
findings.fix: An outcome is named by the card (for the one part that owns it) or by the part's own words, else unknown.

findings.defect: A detected kind was chosen even from another family or refuted, and nothing said so.
findings.scenario: Fraud words, confirmed, then the parts removed down to the rings: it routed to binary, blocked by labels, with the reason 'keeps the kind the detection found'.
findings.cause: The detection won whatever the map said.
findings.fix: The detection is used for a single problem the rules drew; a person's own single map is routed by its family; a refuted kind is chosen and the refutation is in the reason and on the page.

findings.defect: The file of known cases counted as a second table.
findings.scenario: The rides and a cases file gave '2 tables', so the entity kind was chosen with no table of events.
findings.fix: Tables beside the labels are counted.

findings.defect: A city and a zip made two columns of place.
findings.scenario: A regression part with only city and zip routed to the places kind, which needs a latitude and longitude pair.
findings.fix: A pair of latitude and longitude columns, found as the library's own detection finds it.

findings.defect: A small count was refuted as a number.
findings.scenario: An outcome of eleven whole values blocked regression and places, so nothing was chosen.
findings.cause: A number needed more than twenty values.
findings.fix: A float is a number; a whole number of few values is unknown; text is refuted.

findings.defect: A rare event with labels not yet said went to the screen with no labels.
findings.scenario: A person-added rare-event part (labels unknown) was routed to anomaly because it had fewer unknown needs.
findings.cause: The fewer unknown needs came before the more specific approach.
findings.fix: Order by refutation, the kind the map names, specificity, then unknown needs.

findings.defect: Decisions were recorded again for parts that had not changed, and two parts were alike.
findings.scenario: Confirm, remove a part, confirm: seven decisions, three repeated; a ticket's team and urgency records were identical.
findings.cause: Edits rebuilt the stored map without its routes; the record named only the draft.
findings.fix: The routes are carried across edits; the data digest is the snapshot the routes were made against; each record names its sub-problem.

findings.defect: Catalogue needs were missing or guessed.
findings.scenario: Streams did not ask for the incidents table, uplift for a binary outcome, forecasting for a number; a treatment or duration not found by name refuted the family's only approach; a card with no purposes made time, entity and place false.
findings.cause: Needs were written from the kinds' titles, not their fields.
findings.fix: The needs follow the kinds' own fields; a name not found is unknown; a card without purposes leaves those needs unknown; the kind the map names is asked first.

findings.defect: A model could choose a candidate whose needs nothing had met.
findings.scenario: With no data card a model chose text_tabular, whose needs were all unknown.
findings.fix: A model's choice must have its needs met, unless it is the rules' own choice; a route made for another map is not attached by the adapter.

findings.defect: Tests that could not fail, and paths no test reached.
findings.scenario: Two assertions were always true; deleting the coordinator's call that routes again after the analysis left everything passing; no test had a card with no named outcome.
findings.cause: Tests were written from the first draft's behaviour.
findings.fix: The assertions say what they claim; the hook is tested; every engine kind must be in the catalogue; a card with no outcome, a stale route, a route that no longer reads and a map edited down to one part are tested.

outcome: Each part of a map is routed to an approach from a catalogue of the engine's own kinds, with the others and what blocks them; the fraud words route to a screen, a rare event, entity tables and a budgeted review; every kind's replica routes first to that kind; a model may only choose among candidates the data does not refute.
lessons: A need nobody has judged is unknown, and unknown is not refused: a guess refutes the right answer.
A card that names one outcome is judged only for the part that owns it.
A test over the replicas that names the outcome and the family by hand hides the guess it was meant to catch: also test the card that names nothing.
A record of a decision names what it is about: two parts of one draft must not be alike.
risks: The router role serves only after the sealed measurement of 24.8.
The catalogue's needs follow the kinds' fields at this commit: a kind that changes its needs changes the catalogue's, and a test holds that every kind is in it.
